subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a focused cron timeline first slice in the Control UI, or require the broader day/week calendar and rescheduling design before implementation?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Control UI mode rather than a broken existing contract, and the current linked PR is stale/conflicting while implementing only part of the requested scope.

options.title: Request fresh timeline PR
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a fresh or heavily rebased implementation against ui/src/pages/cron/view.ts that preserves current cron contracts.

options.title: Adopt and repair linked branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor the linked branch and own the larger rebase plus scheduler/status/i18n correctness work.

options.title: Defer broader calendar scope
options.body: Keep or close the feature direction after deciding that the current list/run-history UI is enough for core for now.

recommendation.title: Request fresh timeline PR
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a fresh or heavily rebased implementation against ui/src/pages/cron/view.ts that preserves current cron contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has recent Control UI architecture history and is the best available routing signal for the web UI product surface decision.
